composition_subtypes.role: 1D DP to find longest contiguous sorted block of values with non-overlapping index intervals

payload.core_composition_summary: Uses DP on sorted unique values to count longest sequence of values that appear in non-overlapping original intervals, then subtracts from total.
payload.rationale: The solution's core is DP; sorting is just preprocessing. No greedy exchange or amortized analysis. Single-mechanism DP.
